classes.name: Pyromancer
classes.lore: A reincarnated crimson archmage wielding ancient primordial fire. Incinerates the battlefield, stacks explosive embers upon foes, and commands lingering flames.
classes.passive: Burns stack up to 3 times. Each one does 4 damage at the start of its victim's turn.

opponent.name: Ashka the Kindled
lines: You were summoned to this world only to turn to ash.
The crimson flame fades... but embers will reignite.

classes.name: Windwalker
classes.lore: An agile galeblade summoned from beyond the tempest. Strikes across the battlefield via ethereal wind relays, displacing adversaries and leaving howling vortexes.
classes.passive: Relay: your air spells go out from your relay whenever it reaches, and hit 30% harder from there.

opponent.name: Sef of the Long Grass
lines: In this realm, the wind never blows in the same place twice.
You caught the wind... How could an otherworldly traveler match my speed?

classes.name: Tidecaller
classes.lore: A mystical water sage blessed by the Astral Depths. Manipulates frost, torrents, and aquatic sanctuaries to restrict enemy movement while restoring vitality.
classes.passive: Your water slows enemies by 1 MP and heals you 5 when you start a turn in it. Water puts fire out.

opponent.name: Mother Brine
lines: Welcome to the sacred springs, wanderer. Rest peacefully beneath the tides.
The tide recedes... It seems your otherworldly blessing runs deeper.

classes.name: Stonewarden
classes.lore: An indomitable fortress knight infused with titanic leyline earth. Charges across the field, traps enemies within stone ramparts, and crushes nearby targets with brutal melee force.
classes.passive: +50% damage against a target right next to you. Hard to move: pushes carry you 2 cells less.

opponent.name: Old Grund
lines: No blessing or cheat skill from another world can pierce bedrock.
Even mountains crumble with time... Well fought, traveler.
